description: Create professional learning and instructional-coaching materials for K-12 educators: classroom observation / look-for tools, coaching conversation guides, and professional development (PD) session plans. Use this whenever an instructional coach, PD facilitator, or teacher-leader needs adult-learning resources — phrasings like 'a look-for tool for…', 'a coaching guide for a teacher working on…', 'plan a PD session on…', or 'observation form focused on…'. It grounds resources in adult-learning principles, keeps coaching non-evaluative and growth-oriented, and ties look-fors to concrete, observable practice. Make sure to use this whenever the audience is educators (not students or families). Do NOT use it for evaluative administrator walkthroughs / implementation monitoring (school-administration) or for student-facing lessons (lesson-planner) — this skill supports teacher growth, not evaluation.
